label: Fugue in C minor, BWV 575
caution: Read from Tobi's MusicXML file (Tobis Notenarchiv), notes, ties and names as they stand there; the voices were sorted by this program from the file's staves, stems and beams, and have not been proofread note by note. The pedal comes in only for the last eleven bars; until then the bass is in the left hand.
title: Fugue in C minor, BWV 575

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence falling by a third every half bar.
sections.leads: From G minor to C minor; perfect cadence in C minor at bar 23

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times). Bass: the opening of the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted.
sections.leads: Between two statements in C minor; perfect cadence in G major at bar 31

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every beat. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From C minor to G minor; perfect cadence in G minor at bar 37

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times) and the opening of the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Alto: the opening of the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every beat. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a fourth every half bar. Returns in Episode 5 (bars 50–51).
sections.leads: From G minor to C minor; perfect cadence in F minor at bar 44; perfect cadence in C minor at bar 47

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 4 (bars 40–47) in part, in the same voices, at the same pitch. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From C minor to G minor

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence rising by a third every half bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and the opening of the subject, in a sequence rising by a third every half bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a third every half bar.
sections.leads: From G minor to C minor

sections.label: Episode 7
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (7 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every beat. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every beat. Bass: a figure from the subject (7 times), in a sequence falling by a step every beat.

sections.label: Coda
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in G major at bar 69
